Makes amount: -1 for all, 1 or 5 by their buttons, any other number through the X prompt. The quantity is confirm ed on the panel before the slot is clicked. Typed amounts are not yet proven on this panel. 1, 5 and All go by their own buttons; All is the one seen working in the test run. An amount that needs the X prompt has not been run here, and on the silver panel next door a typed amount was accepted by the prompt but never shown, so it could not be confirm ed. Until a run says otherwise, prefer 1, 5 or All. W hat true m eans. The slot was clicked. W atch the backpack to know what was m ade. PestControl - Class in org.dreambot.api.methods.minigame
The Pest Control minigame as an API: the in-game data a script reads, and the reward interface it acts on. The bot's logic - roles, portal targeting, combat, gate repair, boarding, point thresholds - is deliberately not here; that belongs to your script. This gives it what to see and what to click. XPE-original: DreamBot has no Pest Control class. Every member is static and nothing throws - a read returns a safe default (0, -1, false, null, or an empty map) when it cannot answer, and an interact returns false and does nothing.

The Void Knight's remaining hitpoints, from the overlay. 0 when it cannot be read. Tile voidKnightTile() The Void Knight's tile in the current game, or null if it is not on screen. Portals - enum PestControl.Portal XPE Script API · Pest Control Page 2 The four portals, by compass position and the combat style each is weak to. A portal is told apart from the others by its position relative to the Void Knight; its NPC id says only whether the shield is up. unshieldedId() - Static method in class org.dreambot.api.methods.minigame.PestControl
The portal's compass name, the style it is weak to, and its two NPC ids. Statics NPC portalNpc(Portal type) Finds a portal's NPC by position relative to the Void Knight; null if the knight or the portal is not found. Map<Portal,Integer> portalHealthMap() Per-portal hitpoints read from the overlay, cached 600ms. An empty or partial map means unknown - never treat a missing portal as 0. On the health map's fallback. It prefers letter-tagged texts ("W: 250"). Failing that, it maps exactly four bare numbers in overlay order W, E, SE, SW - confirm that order once in a live game. isShielded()/isVulnerable(), read off the NPC id, do not depend on it. The reward interface. XPE method.

pointsKnown() - Static method in class org.dreambot.api.methods.minigame.PestControl
Whether the total is readable right now - i.e. the shop is open. Why points read -1 when the shop is shut. The total lives in varp 261, but the game reuses that slot for genie-lamp and item-retrieval state the moment the shop closes. So a blind read outside the shop returns garbage - a frozen 0, or a plausible-looking wrong number. Read it only while open, and estimate earnings between visits in your script. Spending - enums Skill and Reward Each enum value clicks its own button off the open interface, by the exact menu text - which is checked against a live widget dump by the built-in rig. boolean Skill.interact(int points) Buys 1, 10 or 100 points of this skill's XP from the open interface. False for any other amount or a closed interface. String Skill.action(int points) The menu action it clicks, e.g. "Attack XP: 100 points"; null if the amount is not 1/10/100. Note the singular "point" at 1. boolean Reward.interact() Buys this reward from the open interface. Some rewards prompt a confirmation dialogue this does not answer - handle that with the dialogue API. String Reward.action() The interface action that buys this reward. Statics. XPE method.
